name: GetManyLoadBalancers
label: Get Many AWS ELB Load Balancers
description: Retrieves multiple load balancers from AWS Elastic Load Balancing (ALB/NLB).

fields.name: AWSServiceVaultId
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: Select the AWS credential to use for authentication (AWSServiceVaultId).

fields.name: ReturnAll
fields.label: Return All
fields.description: If enabled, retrieves all load balancers (up to AWS limit). Otherwise, limits results by 'Limit'.

fields.name: Limit
fields.label: Limit
fields.description: Maximum number of load balancers to return (max 100). Default: 100.

fields.name: Region
fields.label: AWS Region
fields.description: The AWS region where the load balancers are located (e.g., us-east-1). Default: us-east-1.

fields.name: LoadBalancers
fields.label: Load Balancers
fields.description: List of retrieved load balancers (ARN, DNS name, state, etc.).

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from AWS ELB.
